pages.text: The Dimensional Anchor draws 100 Source per second from providers within 8 blocks. While powered, it keeps its own chunk loaded and running.
Surround it at the same height with eight Arcane Structural Frames to enable expansion mode. This keeps a centered 3×3 chunk area loaded and costs 900 Source per second.
If Source runs out, redstone pauses it, its expansion frame changes, or it is broken, the Anchor immediately unloads chunks it no longer maintains.
Empty-hand use previews the expansion frame, and the Matrix Construction Wand places missing blocks. Cross-dimensional Source and storage links require their remote nodes to remain loaded.
